scenes.heading: scenefile
scenes.sub: Turn a small JSON file into a video: scenes, narration and captions.
scenes.say: This is scenefile. It turns a small JSON file into a video, with narration and captions.

scenes.text: Built so a model that cannot see can still get the video right.
scenes.say: It is built so that a language model that cannot see images can still get the video right.
Install it with one command. Then check the file, and render it.

scenes.heading: Languages, by share of the code
scenes.say: It is written almost entirely in TypeScript.

scenes.heading: Find it on GitHub.
scenes.say: You can find it on GitHub.
